01

The root-canal page contains the wrong treatment copy

The Root Canal Therapy page describes inlays and onlays in its body, costs and FAQs.

  • Replace the inlay/onlay sections with approved root-canal content on this exact page; keep its root-canal URL.
02

Comfort-service links lead to missing pages

Five comfort destinations return 404 from 35 body links; llms.txt also lists a missing comfort hub.

  • Confirm which services are offered, then restore the right pages or remove/update their links.
  • Use the complete source-link map; redirect only to a genuinely matching approved destination, not the homepage.

03

Business and doctor schema have incorrect fields

Organization schema contains an unrelated phone number, and the doctor's Person schema points to a missing photo.

  • Change Organization contactPoint.telephone from +18012620744 to +13236605522; preserve legitimate tracking numbers.
  • Replace the Person image URL ending /2025/01/lianna-damargi.jpg with a verified current doctor photo.
04

First-screen backgrounds are discovered late

Mobile scored 59/100 with a 6.98-second lab LCP; #section-41-74’s 14 KB platter background had a 1.88-second observed request-discovery delay.

  • Make the needed first-screen CSS/background requests available earlier for sections #section-2-74 and #section-41-74.
  • Preserve CSS/script dependencies and retest; further compressing these 14 KB backgrounds is not the main fix.
05

Blog cards use large image files

The blog archive references a 1.23 MB toothbrush image and a 1.13 MB wisdom-tooth image for article cards.

  • Serve properly sized, quality-preserving card images and lazy-load cards below the first screen; keep originals for larger views.

Fix order

Correct the treatment copy and broken visitor paths first, then the source data and loading work.

  • Content + website: root-canal copy and approved comfort-page decisions.
  • Website + SEO: one schema cleanup, measured speed retest and implant indexing follow-up.

Lab speed is not real-user speed; only one independent mobile PSI result. Comfort destinations require a service/content decision. No website or account changes made.
